name: Next Mediaworks Limited
summary: Next Mediaworks Limited engages in the media and entertainment business in India. The company engages in multimedia; broadcasting; marketing of television programs, films, and software; and advertising agent activities. It also provides online and interactive information and news for business and general use; deals in internet commerce and all internet-related activities; and prints and publishes newspapers, journals, magazine books, and other literary works, etc. The company was formerly known as Mid-Day Multimedia Limited and changed its name to Next Mediaworks Limited in April 2011. Next Mediaworks Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in New Delhi, India. Next Mediaworks Limited is a subsidiary of HT Media Limited.
